empty.filtered_hint: Reset the filters to see all tasks

modal.comment_placeholder: Write a comment… Redmine markup is supported

kanban.title: Kanban
kanban.move_rejected: Redmine did not accept the change: its settings forbid this transition. The task was put back.
kanban.move_no_source: The data source is not configured — the change was not saved
kanban.move_forbidden: No access to the project of this task
kanban.read_only: You have read-only access — tasks cannot be moved

sprint.title: Sprints
sprint.action_forbidden: You have no right to do this with a sprint

backlog_filter.placeholder: Project, task subject or number — then Enter

sprint.no_data: No data. Make sure projects are selected in the filter.

data.title: Dashboard Data Filtering
data.projects_hint: Select projects to display. Data for unselected projects will be hidden in all sections.

sync.title: Synchronization
sync.hint: Log of data synchronization runs from the source system.
sync.interval_invalid: The interval is a whole number from {min} to {max} minutes
sync.not_configured: The data source is not configured

priorities.title: Priority order
priorities.name: Name
priorities.order_hint: The larger the number, the more important the priority. The priority with the largest number is counted as High in Analytics and highlighted in deadlines; tasks are sorted by this order.

statuses.title: Status groups
statuses.hint: Assign statuses to groups. This drives the Tasks filters and the numbers in Analytics, Kanban and Sprint. The setting is shared by all users.
statuses.admin_hint: Click a status, then a column to move it. The bug icon marks a status as Bugs — such tasks are counted in the Bugs figures in Analytics.
statuses.readonly_hint: Only an administrator can change status groups.

sprint.tasks: Change the tasks of a sprint

errors.USER_EXISTS: A user with this login already exists
errors.CANNOT_DEMOTE_SELF: You cannot remove the administrator role from yourself
errors.GROUP_EXISTS: A group with this name already exists
errors.TEMPLATE_EXISTS: A template with this name already exists
errors.SOURCE_NOT_FOUND: The source of the rights was not found
errors.TARGET_NOT_FOUND: The recipient of the rights was not found

users.title: Users
users.hint: The Administrator role gives full access. Everybody else gets rights from a role template, groups or an individual setup (the shield icon). Without a template and rights a user sees only their own tasks.
users.name: Name
users.no_member_hint: Users link themselves to Redmine with a personal API key — on the first login or in Personal settings
users.new_hint: On the first login the user changes the password and enters their Redmine API key.
users.template_replaces_title: Replace individual rights with the template?
users.template_replaces_text: The rights of this user are set individually. Choosing a template resets them.

rights.title: Access rights: {name}
rights.inherited_hint: The user's own rights come from the role template. They can be set individually — then changes of the template no longer affect this user.
rights.individual_hint: Individual rights replace the role template. The user's groups add no access, they only narrow it: what remains is the projects and members allowed both here and in the groups. If tabs, widgets or sprint actions are set in a group of the user, the group's settings apply.
rights.save_as_template: Create a template from current rights

editor.own_tasks_hint: Tasks assigned to the user are always visible, in any project
editor.read_only_hint: Data can be viewed, but tasks cannot be changed and comments cannot be written
editor.from_source: Projects as in the source system
editor.from_source_hint: The user gets the projects they are a member of in Redmine and sees only the members Redmine shows them in these projects. The lists are read with their personal API key: projects on every synchronization, members once an hour; until the key is entered there are no such projects.
editor.covered_by_parent: Covered by the ticked parent project
editor.show_unassigned_hint: Without this tick tasks that have no assignee are not shown to the user
editor.projects_note: A right to a project covers all its subprojects, including the ones created later.

password.confirm_text: A temporary password will be created. On the next login the user will have to set a new one.
password.title: Temporary password
password.hint: Pass this password to user {name}. It is shown once.
password.copy_failed: Could not copy — select the password manually

groups.title: Groups
groups.hint: A group restricts its members: of the user's own projects and members only those allowed by the group remain. A group adds no access. With several groups, what at least one of them allows is allowed.
groups.name: Name
groups.rights_hint: The projects and members here are the limit for a member of the group: they see only those of their own that are checked. If no projects or no members are checked, the group does not restrict them. Tabs, widgets and sprint actions set in a group have priority over the member's own settings.
groups.delete_text: The restrictions the group put on its members will no longer apply.

templates.title: Role templates
templates.hint: A template sets the rights of many users at once. A change of a template applies to everyone who has it, except those whose rights are set individually.
templates.name: Template name
templates.edit_hint: Changes apply to every user with this template.
templates.admin_hint: This template assigns the Administrator role: full access to all data and settings, no restrictions apply.
templates.delete_text_users: Users with this template: {n}. They keep their current rights, which become Custom.

source_token.title: Link to Redmine
source_token.hint: A personal API key shows who you are in Redmine: your tasks are found by it, and your changes go to Redmine under your name. Only you can set or change the key.
source_token.prompt_text: To see your tasks and make changes under your own name, enter your personal API key from Redmine.
source_token.help: Where to find it: Redmine → My account → API access key → Show.
source_token.linked: You are linked to Redmine as {name}.
source_token.unlink_text: The key will be deleted. Changes will go to Redmine on behalf of the system again, and your own tasks will no longer be recognised.

errors.TOKEN_INVALID: Redmine did not accept this key. Check that it is copied in full.
errors.TOKEN_ALREADY_LINKED: This Redmine account is already linked to another user.
errors.DATA_SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE: Redmine is not available right now. Try again later.
errors.DATA_SOURCE_NOT_CONFIGURED: The data source is not configured.

license.title: License
license.ask_admin: Only a system administrator can activate the license. Please contact them.
license.load_error: Failed to load the license details

text.grace: The last license check failed. The system works in full until {time}, then it switches to read-only mode.
text.read_only: The grace period is over: data can be viewed but not changed. Load a valid license to restore full access.
text.not_activated: Until the license is activated the system cannot be used. Send the hardware fingerprint to the vendor and load the license file you receive.

reason.signature: The license signature did not verify
reason.hwid_mismatch: The hardware of the server is not the one the license was issued for
reason.hwid_unavailable: The hardware fingerprint of the server could not be read

license.hwid_hint: Send this string to the vendor — the license is issued for it.
license.hwid_missing: The hardware fingerprint is not available. It is collected automatically at start; docker compose logs hwid shows the reason. If it cannot be collected automatically, run scripts/collect-hwid.sh on the server (not in the container) as root and restart the backend container.
license.copy_failed: Could not copy — select the string manually
license.token_hint: Paste the license token or load the license file (.lic) received from the vendor.

errors.LICENSE_FORMAT_INVALID: This is not a license token: check that it is copied in full.
errors.LICENSE_SIGNATURE_INVALID: The license signature is not valid.
errors.LICENSE_HWID_MISMATCH: The license was issued for another server: the hardware fingerprint does not match.
errors.HWID_UNAVAILABLE: The hardware fingerprint of the server is not available — there is nothing to bind the license to.

banner.grace: The license check failed. From {time} the system will be read-only.
banner.read_only: The system is in read-only mode: changes are unavailable until a valid license is loaded.
